findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking on the hand sink int he kitchen was observed to be coming off. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the hand sink will be caulked to the wall properly. Ensure that the hand sink is caulked to the wall providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspector observed pork being stored over cooked breaded shrimp and raw veggies in the walk-in cooler. Discussed with PIC and PIC removed to raw pork to be stored properly. Ensure that appropriate storage order is observed to avoid cross contamination of food items.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: A scoop with a dirty handle was observed lying sideways in the sugar storage container. Discuss with PIC and the scoop was taken out to be cleaned. Ensure that food contact surfaces are routinely monitored and cleaned to avoid contamination of food items. [Pf]
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: A bowl was observed containing shrimp in water thawing in the walk in refrigerator. Discuss with PIC and the thawing method was corrected. The Shrimp was received frozen and was put in the bowl of water and placed in the refrigerator to be thawed. Ensure that the adequate thawing methods are used for food items. [C]
findings.citation_text: 3-303.12 Storage or Display of Food in Contact with Water or Ice. (A) PACKAGED FOOD may not be stored in direct contact with ice or water if the FOOD is subject to the entry of water because of the nature of its packaging, wrapping, or container or its positioning in the ice or water (B) Except as specified in (C) and (D) of this section, unPACKAGED FOOD may not be stored in direct contact with undrained ice. (C) Whole, raw fruits or vegetables; cut, raw vegetables such as celery or carrot sticks or cut potatoes; and tofu may be immersed in ice or water. (D) Raw poultry and raw FISH that are received immersed in ice in shipping containers may remain in that condition while in storage awaiting preparation, display, service, or sale.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed to have the accumulation of soils. 
1. The exterior of the storage containers in the dry storage appeared to have an accumulation of soils. 
2. The accumulation of grease was observed on the top of the shelving on the grill.
3. The rice cooker table next to the fryer was observed to have an accumulation of grease build up on the sides and underneath.
4. The accumulation of ice buildup was observed in the sitting freezer at the entrance of the walk-in fridge.
Discuss with PIC and PIC noted that the above mentioned areas would be cleaned. Ensure that equipments in a facility are routinely monitored and cleaned to avoid the accumulation of soils. Make sure that food contact surfaces and non-food contact surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable. [C]

6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

One of the sugar storage containers was observed broken. Discussed with PIC and the container will be replaced. Ensure that storage containers are continuously checked for possible repairs.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed to have an accumulation of soils/debris:
-The phone used to take call in orders had an accumulation of food debris. 
-The bottom of the right stand up freezer is observed with food debris. 
-The ledge of the chest freezer is observed with food debris. 
Ensure these areas are cleaned to remove the current accumulation of food debris and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
